source(output(
		Zip as string,
		{Procedure Code} as string,
		{Date of Birth} as string,
		{Medicaid  ID} as string,
		{Primary Diagnosis} as string,
		{Authorization Status} as string,
		City as string,
		{LDH Authorization Types} as string,
		{Provider NPI} as string,
		{Provider Name} as string,
		{Authorization End Date} as string,
		{Type of Service} as string,
		{Member First Name} as string,
		{Authorization Number} as string,
		{Authorization Start Date} as string,
		{Units Approved} as integer,
		State as string,
		{Member Last Name} as string,
		{Provider Address} as string,
		Modifier as string,
		{Provider TIN} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  CAST([Authorization Number] AS NVARCHAR(9)) AS [Authorization Number] ,CAST([Medicaid  ID] AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS [Medicaid  ID] ,CAST([Member First Name] AS NVARCHAR(15)) AS [Member First Name] ,CAST([Member Last Name] AS NVARCHAR(35)) AS [Member Last Name] ,[Date of Birth] ,CAST([Provider NPI] AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS [Provider NPI] ,CAST([Provider TIN] AS NVARCHAR(9)) AS [Provider TIN] ,CAST([Provider Name] AS NVARCHAR(55)) AS [Provider Name] ,CAST([Provider Address] AS NVARCHAR(40)) AS [Provider Address] ,CAST([City] AS NVARCHAR(19)) AS [City] ,CAST([State] AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS [State] ,CAST([Zip] AS NVARCHAR(11)) AS [Zip] ,CAST([Type of Service] AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS [Type of Service] ,CAST([Primary Diagnosis] AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS [Primary Diagnosis] ,[Authorization Start Date] ,[Authorization End Date] ,CAST([Authorization Status] AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS [Authorization Status] ,CAST([Procedure Code] AS NVARCHAR(7)) AS [Procedure Code] ,CAST([Modifier] AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS [Modifier] ,[Units Approved] ,CAST([LDH Authorization Types] AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS [LDH Authorization Types] FROM [EXTRACT].[LA_TOC_OUTBOUND] WHERE [INBOUND_PLAN] = \'AETNA\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
